name: Can replacing bedroom windows reduce noise from outside?

mainEntity.name: Can replacing bedroom windows reduce noise from outside?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, replacing old, single-pane windows with new, high-quality windows can significantly reduce outside noise. Features like double or triple-pane glass, laminated glass, and inert gas fills (argon/krypton) between panes help dampen sound waves. A tight, proper installation also prevents sound from leaking through gaps. This improvement can create a much quieter and more peaceful sleeping environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: New, high-quality windows with features like double-pane or laminated glass can significantly reduce outside noise, creating a quieter bedroom.
